paper.title: Herd behavior and aggregate fluctuations in financial markets

headline: Cont-Bouchaud 2000 percolation market: 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; c=1,a=0.05 excess kurtosis=3.56 vs high-a control -0.23; P(|r|>3s)=0.0208 (Gaussian 0.0027); tail exponent 3.36

verdicts.gate: P1 fat tails at criticality: pooled excess kurtosis > 3 and > 5x near-Gaussian control
P2 heavy tails vs Gaussian: P(|r|>3s)>=0.008 & >=3x Gaussian, P(|r|>5s)>=10x Gaussian, exponent in [1.5,4]
P3 activity crossover to Gaussian: kurtosis(a=0.05) >= 3x kurtosis(a=0.49) and monotone decrease

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the fat-tailed / excess-kurtosis stylized fact from percolation-threshold clustering, isolate criticality + low activity as its cause, and would catch an artifact

citations: Cont, R. & Bouchaud, J.-P. (2000). Herd behavior and aggregate fluctuations in financial markets. Macroeconomic Dynamics 4:170-196. doi:10.1017/S1365100500015029.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the standardized-return excess kurtosis + heavy-tail probabilities + tail exponent
